description: Docudesk document templates for Shillinq. Registered via ConfigurationService::importFromApp() on install.

templates.name: WBSO Mededeling
templates.description: Quarterly RvO mededeling of realised S&O hours and loonkosten per project per quarter. Populated from the mededelingPerKwartaal aggregation on SoUrenStaat (state ≠ draft) per REQ-WBSO-003.

outputChannel.description: Transmit the completed mededeling to RvO via the openconnector rvo-wbso-submissions source per REQ-WBSO-005.

templates.name: WBSO Kwartaalrapportage
templates.description: Quarterly progress narrative per S&O project including per-employee hours totals. Generated from urenPerMedewerkerPerKwartaal aggregation per REQ-WBSO-004.

outputChannel.description: Transmit kwartaalrapportage to RvO via the openconnector rvo-wbso-submissions source per REQ-WBSO-005.

templates.name: WBSO Jaarrapport
templates.description: Annual close report summing the four kwartaalmededelingen per project. The sum MUST equal the sum of the four kwartaalmededelingen per REQ-WBSO-004 scenario invariant.

aggregationFilter.description: Sum all four quarters for the fiscal year — equivalent to the four kwartaalmededelingen.

outputChannel.description: Transmit jaarrapport to RvO via the openconnector rvo-wbso-submissions source per REQ-WBSO-005.

templates.name: WBSO Aanvraag
templates.description: S&O application template for requesting a new WBSO verklaring from RvO. Populated from SoProject fields.

outputChannel.description: Submit the WBSO aanvraag to RvO via the openconnector rvo-wbso-submissions source per REQ-WBSO-005.
